nodes.label: Candlestick Anatomy Diagram (Japanese Candle)
nodes.description: Educational diagram titled 'Анатомия японской свечи' (Japanese Candlestick Anatomy) showing two candlestick types: bullish (green, C > O) and bearish (red, C < O), labeled with open/close prices and upper/lower shadows (wicks). Price axis shows range ~1.082–1.090.

nodes.label: Bullish Candlestick (Бычья свеча)
nodes.description: Green candlestick where Close > Open. Labeled components: Открытие (Open) at bottom of body, Закрытие (Close) at top of body, Верхняя тень (Upper shadow/wick), Нижняя тень (Lower shadow/wick).

nodes.label: Bearish Candlestick (Медвежья свеча)
nodes.description: Red candlestick where Close < Open. Labeled components: Открытие (Open) at top of body, Закрытие (Close) at bottom of body, upper and lower shadows visible.

nodes.label: Upper Shadow (Верхняя тень)
nodes.description: The wick extending above the candlestick body, representing the highest price reached during the period.

nodes.label: Lower Shadow (Нижняя тень)
nodes.description: The wick extending below the candlestick body, representing the lowest price reached during the period.

nodes.label: Open Price (Открытие)
nodes.description: Opening price of the candle. Bottom of bullish body (~1.084), top of bearish body (~1.086).

nodes.label: Close Price (Закрытие)
nodes.description: Closing price of the candle. Top of bullish body (~1.086), bottom of bearish body (~1.084).
